ns2:course.label: Programming for GIS
ns2:course.description: Introduction to programming to customize and extend the capabilities of geographic information systems. Topics include the principles of programming, advanced function and tools coding, visualization, fundamental spatial data structures, and spatial algorithms. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: GGIS 379 and GGIS 380 or equivalents, or consent of instructor.
